learnings: Conventional aliases (`np`, `pd`, `dt`) aid readability; single-letter custom aliases hurt it.
`from x import loads as json_loads` resolves real name clashes.
An alias is just another name bound to the same module object.
pitfalls: `tomllib.loads` actually lives in a private submodule – inspect `__module__` rather than assuming.
next: Keep imports sorted and aliased consistently with ruff's `I` rules.
